description.en: Ray diagram showing refraction of monochromatic light through a glass prism. The incident ray suffers two refractions, bending towards the base.
description.hi: कांच के प्रिज्म से होकर एकवर्णी प्रकाश के अपवर्तन को दर्शाने वाला किरण आरेख। आपतित किरण दो बार अपवर्तित होती है, और आधार की ओर झुक जाती है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Prism ABC -->
  <polygon points="250,50 100,350 400,350" fill="#e0f2fe" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5" />
  <text x="245" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">A</text>
  <text x="80" y="360" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">B</text>
  <text x="410" y="360" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold">C</text>

  <!-- Normals at incidence and emergence points -->
  <line x1="115" y1="110" x2="235" y2="290" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5,5" /> <!-- Normal N1 at P -->
  <line x1="385" y1="110" x2="235" y2="290" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5,5" /> <!-- Normal N2 at Q -->
  <text x="235" y="305" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">N</text>

  <!-- Incident Ray -->
  <line x1="50" y1="250" x2="175" y2="200" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="120,222 110,217 116,227" fill="#ef4444" /> <!-- Arrow on incident ray -->

  <!-- Refracted Ray inside prism -->
  <line x1="175" y1="200" x2="325" y2="200" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="260,200 250,195 250,205" fill="#ef4444" /> <!-- Arrow inside -->

  <!-- Emergent Ray -->
  <line x1="325" y1="200" x2="450" y2="250" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="395,228 385,223 391,233" fill="#ef4444" /> <!-- Arrow on emergent ray -->

  <!-- Extended rays for angle of deviation -->
  <line x1="175" y1="200" x2="350" y2="130" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" /> <!-- Extended incident -->
  <line x1="325" y1="200" x2="150" y2="130" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" /> <!-- Extended emergent -->

  <!-- Intersection point M for deviation -->
  <text x="245" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">M</text>

  <!-- Points P and Q on prism faces -->
  <text x="155" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">P</text>
  <text x="335" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">Q</text>

  <!-- Angles -->
  <path d="M155,208 A 20 20 0 0 1 170,185" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="145" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">i</text>

  <path d="M188,200 A 20 20 0 0 1 195,215" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="190" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">r₁</text>

  <path d="M312,200 A 20 20 0 0 0 305,215" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="300" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">r₂</text>

  <path d="M345,208 A 20 20 0 0 0 330,185" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="345" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">e</text>

  <!-- Angle of Deviation -->
  <path d="M275,160 A 30 30 0 0 1 290,140" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="290" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#10b981">δ</text>

</svg>
